title: The humble announcement
text:
I'm humbled and honored to share some news.
Three years ago, I was sleeping on a friend's couch with $40 in my bank account.
Everyone told me to quit.
I didn't.
Today, I'm starting a new role as Head of Growth at Northwind.
But this isn't about me.
It's about every single person who believed in me when I didn't believe in myself.
Agree?
What's one lesson that changed your career? 👇

title: My kid taught me sales
text:
Yesterday, my 6-year-old taught me more about B2B sales than any MBA ever could.
She wanted ice cream.
I said no.
She asked again, but this time she offered to clean her room first.
That's when it hit me.
Lead with value, not the ask.
We rolled this into our outbound playbook and reply rates went from 2% to 9%.
Let that sink in.
♻️ Repost if this resonated.

title: Unpopular opinion
text:
Unpopular opinion:
Meetings are not work.
I cancelled every recurring meeting on my team for 30 days.
The result?
We shipped 2 features ahead of schedule and nobody missed the standup.
Here's what I learned 🧵

title: 47 rejections
text:
I got rejected 47 times.
47.
Most people would have given up.
But I kept showing up, every single day.
Last week, I accepted an offer to join Contoso as a senior designer.
Rejection is just redirection.
If you're in the trenches right now, keep going.
Your yes is coming. 💪
#OpenToWork #Grateful #NeverGiveUp

title: Laid off on a Tuesday
text:
I was laid off on a Tuesday.
No warning.
No goodbye.
Just a 15-minute call and a locked laptop.
I sat in my car for an hour.
Then I opened a notebook and wrote down everything I'd learned.
Today I'm launching Tallyleaf, a bookkeeping tool for freelancers.
Sometimes the end is actually the beginning.
Who else has turned a setback into a comeback? 👇

title: Thought leadership
text:
In today's fast-paced digital landscape, leadership is more important than ever.
It's not just about managing people.
It's about inspiring them.
Here's the thing: great leaders don't have all the answers.
They ask better questions.
At our offsite, we replaced status updates with one question: what's blocking you?
Blockers surfaced three weeks earlier on average.
Let that sink in.
What's your take? Drop it in the comments. 🚀

title: The circle-back email
text:
Hi team,
I hope this email finds you well.
I just wanted to quickly circle back on the Q3 numbers.
Per my last email, the deadline is Friday.
Sorry to bother you, but could you please send your forecasts by Thursday?
Thanks in advance!
